params.name: history
params.description: Whether to include dropped schemas that have not yet been purged. Default: `false`.

params.name: kind
params.description: Type of schema to create. Currently, Snowflake supports only `transient` and `permanent` (also represented by the empty string).

items.docs: Creates a schema, with modifiers as query parameters. You must provide the full schema definition when creating a schema.

params.name: kind
params.description: Type of schema to clone. Currently, Snowflake supports only `transient` and `permanent` (also represented by the empty string).

params.name: targetDatabase
params.description: Database of the newly created schema. Defaults to the source schema's database.

items.docs: Clones an existing schema, with modifiers as query parameters. You must provide the full schema definition when cloning an existing schema.

info.name: Create a New, or Alters an Existing, Schema.

params.name: kind
params.description: Type of schema to create. Currently, Snowflake supports only `transient` and `permanent` (also represented by the empty string).

items.docs: Creates a new, or alters an existing, schema. You must provide the full schema definition even when altering an existing schema.

params.name: restrict
params.description:
Whether to drop the schema if foreign keys exist that reference any tables in the schema.
- `true`: Return a warning about existing foreign key references and don't drop the schema.
- `false`: Drop the schema and all objects in the database, including tables with primary or unique keys that are referenced by foreign keys in other tables.
Default: `false`.

items.docs: Deletes the specified schema. If you enable the `ifExists` parameter, the operation succeeds even if the schema does not exist. Otherwise, a 404 failure is returned if the schema does not exist. if the drop is unsuccessful.
